profile.headline: Sr. Software & Data Engineer @ Rokt | Building ML systems and data pipelines at scale | Ad tech, distributed systems, LLMs
profile.summary: 🚀 Software & Data Engineer who loves solving complex problems and building scalable, high-performance systems. Whether it’s optimizing data pipelines, enhancing backend services, or fine-tuning ad performance, I’m all about creating efficient and impactful solutions. 💡 I enjoy working with C#, Python, Kafka, and PostgreSQL and always look for ways to make systems smarter and faster. Big fan of collaborating, learning, and mentoring - because tech is more fun when we grow together! 🤝 Outside of work, you’ll probably find me traveling, trying new food, or just enjoying a good cup of coffee. ☕ Let’s connect!

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built an LLM-powered analytics agent (LangSmith + OpenAI APIs) that lets teams query advertising datasets in plain English - translates questions to SQL, runs them against billions of rows in ClickHouse, and returns charts with follow-up suggestions. Cut ad-hoc data turnaround from days to minutes.
- Working on a real-time ML suppression model for a payments page handling millions of daily transactions. The model decides whether showing a third-party ad risks checkout abandonment based on purchase history, session signals, and transaction context - suppressing ads for high-risk users to protect merchant conversion rates while maximizing ad revenue.
- Own the analytics data stack: Iceberg, PySpark/EMR, Airflow, ClickHouse. Hundreds of millions of records daily across attribution, reporting, and ML feature pipelines. Set up Datadog monitoring for pipeline health, SLAs, and data freshness.
-  Tech-led the Partner Activation and Success team; how ad partners get configured, targeted, and served in the marketplace. Built out marketplace config, targeting rules, and audience segmentation. Owned the delivery roadmap and drove technical design across teams.
- Owned the ecommerce and events API service on K8s - the core integration layer partners use to retrieve personalized ads, stream engagement data, and manage transactions at scale. Led technical decisions, API design, and reliability improvements.
- Mentor engineers through design reviews and pairing. Contribute to architecture decisions around data modeling, pipeline reliability, and system design.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Full Stack & Data
positions.description:
- Led the rebuild of the ad attribution system (Attribution 3.0), replacing a tightly coupled legacy monolith with a Kafka-based micro-batch pipeline running on EMR and Spark Streaming. Designed the event ingestion layer, deduplication logic, and multi-touch attribution windowing rules from scratch. The new system processes hundreds of millions of daily ad events (impressions, clicks, conversions) with sub-minute latency while reducing infrastructure costs by ~$20K/month.
- Built and shipped an ML scoring system (Smart Interaction) that evaluates ad relevance at impression time, predicting which users are most likely to engage meaningfully with an ad rather than ignore or accidentally click. Rolled out in three phased releases with A/B testing at each stage; improved cost-per-outcome by ~5% and reduced non-relevant ad impressions by ~10%.
- Developed customer-facing reporting dashboards in React and TypeScript that give advertising partners real-time visibility into how their integrations are performing — including revenue trends, transaction volumes, conversion metrics, and historical comparisons across millions of daily transactions.
- Worked across the full stack from day one: backend services in Python and Java, real-time data pipelines in PySpark and Kafka, frontend dashboards in React, and cloud infrastructure on AWS (EMR, S3, Airflow, ClickHouse).
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Apache Spark and +15 skills

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.locationName: Parsippany, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Led migration from IBM WebSphere to Liberty Profile, opening up containerized Kubernetes deployments across ADP's payroll and HR systems; maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines throughout the migration
- Built an internal SRE dashboard in Splunk that brought monitoring and debugging into one place; cut incident investigation time by 30–35%.
- Developed and maintained backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot for ADP's core payroll and HR platform.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: North Brunswick, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Delivered enterprise web applications in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL - full stack from API design through UI.
- Refactored legacy modules and optimized SQL queries; improved response times by ~20% and reduced production bugs by ~35%.
- Wrote automation scripts for testing and deployment, cutting manual QA time and speeding up releases.
positions.insights: R (Programming Language), Python (Programming Language) and +4 skills
